subject: Unable to run Deducer on win7

messages.author: 59e24b23b6b00e9d
messages.subject: Unable to run Deducer on win7
parts:
Hi,
I installed Deducer through the console:
"install.packages(c("JGR","Deducer","DeducerExtras"))" and everything
ran fine without any errors.
When running "JGR()", however, I get:
"...\JGR-1_62-x64" is not a valid win32

Any suggestions?

Thanks in advance,
Roey

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Unable to run Deducer on win7
parts:
try double clicking on the JGR-1_62-x64.exe file that what downloaded
to your working directory. or if it is not there, download it from
http://www.rforge.net/JGR/files/ .
